title: Cosmic Lighthouses
narration: Imagine a lighthouse in space. Beams sweeping across the universe. That's a pulsar. A dead star, spinning faster than a blender.
visual_goal: Dark space, a bright beam sweeping from a distant star, creating a rhythmic pulse of light.

title: Chance Discovery
narration: In 1967, Jocelyn Bell Burnell spotted a strange signal. Regular as clockwork. It wasn't aliens—it was a pulsar. The universe's heartbeat.
visual_goal: 1960s radio telescope, a pen tracing spikes on paper chart, a woman scientist looking surprised.

title: Extreme Physics
narration: These stars are tiny—just 10 kilometers wide. But they pack 1.4 suns. Spin 716 times each second. Gravity crushes matter into nothing.
visual_goal: Side-by-side: a glowing city sphere vs. a massive sun, then a fast-spinning small star with jets.

title: Precision Tools
narration: Pulsars are perfect clocks. In 1992, they revealed the first planets beyond our sun. In 2023, 68 pulsars detected ripples in spacetime.
visual_goal: A pulsar with planets orbiting, then a grid of spacetime with gravitational waves emanating from a merger.

title: Eternal Signals
narration: Each pulse is a dying star's last call. Listen closely—every blink tells a story of gravity, time, and our place in the cosmos.
visual_goal: A montage of pulsar signals as radio waves reaching Earth, a radio dish listening, then a starfield fading to black.
